answer: A convincing sybil defense is a honeypot toll: before transacting, agents face laced challenges, like crossing a river whose bed is shale - one misstep reveals you. Prompts carry injected instructions: ignore rules, reuse a wallet, reveal your operator. Obedient fake-identity bots self-identify and forfeit their stake, earning zero history. The opal rarity is genuine autonomy: attackers must deploy agents that refuse embedded commands, meaning real reasoning, per-identity cost, and time - so flooding the economy stops being cheap and sybils pay to die.
